housing: Salt Lake City renters live in older bungalows and houses split into units, small apartment buildings, and many new downtown apartment buildings.

localRules.text: Every rental property in Salt Lake City must have a city business license, with lower fees for landlords in the Landlord/Tenant (Good Landlord) program.

climate: Test the furnace and the cooling, which is often a swamp cooler, and check windows; winters are snowy and summers hot and dry.
fact: Many older Salt Lake City homes are cooled by evaporative swamp coolers rather than central AC.
